paper.title_en: Exact model of a gravitational wave and electromagnetic radiation in DHOST gravity theory: wave solutions and testable effects
paper.abstract_en: Within an analytical non-perturbative framework based on a single exact model, the coupled dynamics of gravitational waves and high-frequency electromagnetic fields is investigated in General Relativity and DHOST gravity. Using an exact gravitational-wave spacetime in an isotropic (null) wave coordinate system, Maxwell's equations are integrated analytically. This analysis provides an exact non-perturbative confirmation from the full field equations that a gravitational wave acts as a waveguide, forming a propagation channel for electromagnetic radiation co-directional with the gravitational wave and generating an effective pure-radiation source. Applying this exact electrodynamic solution to the nonlinear field equations of DHOST class~Ia gravity reveals that the algebraic structure of the DHOST constraint equations enforces a modification of the electromagnetic-wave parameters. Based on this mechanism, an observationally testable effect of scalar frequency drift is derived, providing a direct way to discriminate between General Relativity and modified gravity theories even when their metric tensors share identical functional forms.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在DHOST类Ia引力的精确非微扰框架下研究引力波与高频电磁场的耦合，给出解析电动力学解并导出可观测的标量频率漂移效应，为区分广义相对论与修改引力提供直接判据，理论深度与论证清晰度均较好，与修改引力主题高度相关，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: DHOST引力理论中引力波与电磁辐射的精确模型：波解与可检验效应
decision.abstract_zh: 在一个基于单一精确模型的解析非微扰框架内，研究了广义相对论与DHOST引力中引力波与高频电磁场的耦合动力学。利用各向同性（零）波坐标系中的精确引力波时空，解析地积分了麦克斯韦方程。该分析从完整场方程给出了精确非微扰的确认：引力波充当波导，为与引力波同向传播的电磁辐射形成传播通道，并产生有效的纯辐射源。将这一精确电动力学解应用于DHOST类Ia引力的非线性场方程后揭示出，DHOST约束方程的代数结构迫使电磁波参数发生修改。基于这一机制，导出了可观测检验的标量频率漂移效应，从而提供了一种即使在度规张量具有相同函数形式时也能区分广义相对论与修改引力理论的直接途径。
